# Serena Antonietta – The First Descendant (Nexon)

> A Ranged DPS who maximizes airtime using an exclusive maneuvering device and annihilates enemies with a barrage of bullets from the sky. She grants allies blessings of protection and inflicts fiery judgment upon her enemies. Unofficial fan page: official data (NEXON library, patch notes, Nexon Open API) plus clearly labelled community endgame builds. Status 02.10.2026 (live patch 1.4.4).

## Key facts
- Full name: Serena Antonietta (Update 1.2.10 notes; library story) · in game "Serena" · Descendant ID 101000027
- Voice actor (EN): Jane Jackson (NEXON library)
- Attribute: Fire · Arche: Singular (Sacred Flame, Ascension), Dimension (Soar, Redemption), Passive Divinity
- Release: Update 1.2.10, 13.03.2025, Season 2 "Beyond the Void" · farming: Sigma Sector Dropoff Operations (blueprints, codes, materials); Serena Code needs Amorphous Material Pattern: Serena
- Ultimate Serena: none (as of 02.10.2026) · Synchronization Value 1.177 (since 1.3.34)
- Lv 40 (max) stats: Max HP 1,402 / Max Shield 413 / Max MP 243 / DEF 2,325 / Shield Recovery Out of Combat 3.96 / Shield Recovery In Combat 3.3
- Exclusive modules (Lv 10): Archangel (Transcendent, Almandine, capacity 6); Battlefield Nun (Transcendent, Cerulean, capacity 5); Hymn (Transcendent, Rutile, capacity 5); Divine Surge (Transcendent, Rutile, capacity 3); Hope's Resolution (Ancestors, —, capacity 16)
- Endgame builds (community): Build 1 – Archangel (Mobbing / Onslaught – current skill meta) – Khei_Khan (TFDHub, patch 1.4.4, last updated 02.10.2026); Build 2 – Battlefield Nun (Bossing / single target) – Ornery Biscuit (TFDHub, Update 1.4.3, last updated 20.09.2026); Build 3 – Hymn Gunner (Mobbing with Redemption's Judgment, high Max HP) – Ornery Biscuit (TFDHub, Update 1.4.3, last updated 20.09.2026)
